annotations.title: Send a fixed CV back to the referrers

description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. For a referral request the signed-in user sent and a referrer asked to change (status needs_changes): sends the user's current primary CV (CV chính) back to the referrers at the company. This emails the referrers.

request_id.description: Id of one of the user's own requests, from list_referral_requests.

name: resubmit_referral_request

action.description: The action that was applied: resubmit or confirm_contact.

status.description: The request's new status, when the action changed it.
